title: Pin mutmut version in mutation.yml
description: Review finding (kyzm round): .github/workflows/mutation.yml:93 now pins uv (>=0.11,<0.12) but still installs mutmut unpinned. A mutmut major release could break the mutation-testing workflow output format/API. Pin mutmut with a bounded range consistent with repo conventions (>=x,<y) — check the locally used mutmut version for the lower bound. Discovered from kyzm.
close_reason: Pinned mutmut in .github/workflows/mutation.yml:93: 'pip install "uv>=0.11,<0.12" "mutmut>=2.4,<3"'. Range chosen from evidence: the workflow uses the mutmut 2.x CLI (--paths-to-mutate --runner --no-progress; results; html; .mutmut-cache) and mutmut 3.0.0 removed results/html (verified against PyPI source) — the <3 ceiling is load-bearing, not cosmetic; latest 2.x is 2.5.1, latest overall 3.7.0. Pin is operative: mutmut is absent from pyproject.toml/uv.lock, so uv run mutmut resolves the pip-installed executable. 3x review (kimi-k3): correctness PASS (reviewer verified every flag against mutmut 2.4.1 and 2.5.1 source, python 3.12 compatible), security PASS (satisfiable, none yanked, strict improvement; advisory on cargo-mutants filed as new bead), edge-cases: timeout then retry PASS — mechanics confirmed (pip installs to system python, uv sync --locked only manages the venv so it never prunes the install, uv PATH-fallback behavior itself pinned by the uv bound).
